title: Final Decision
summary: This section documents the final judgments and interpretations made by the Court, affirming the primary judge's rulings and the dismissal of the appeal.
content: 117 So too here. By no stretch of language or syntax do the words of the Guarantee fail to make the appellants liable for the whole of the amounts for which they were sued.118 For those reasons, the appeal should be dismissed. The appellants’ limited success in respect of grounds 3 and 4, advancing arguments not put below, is no reason for costs not to follow the event at first instance and on appeal.
